description: Header file defining the GraphicBuffer class used for managing graphics buffers in Android, including buffer creation, locking, reallocation, and callbacks.

classes.name: GraphicBuffer
classes.description: Class representing a graphics buffer with methods for creation, locking, reallocation, and lifecycle management.

methods.name: from
methods.description: Static method to obtain a sp<GraphicBuffer> from an ANativeWindowBuffer.

methods.name: fromAHardwareBuffer
methods.description: Static method to create a GraphicBuffer from an AHardwareBuffer.

methods.name: toAHardwareBuffer
methods.description: Method to get the AHardwareBuffer associated with this GraphicBuffer.

methods.name: initCheck
methods.description: Returns the status of the initialization.

methods.name: reallocate
methods.description: Reallocates the buffer with new parameters.

methods.name: needsReallocation
methods.description: Checks if reallocation is needed for given parameters.

methods.name: lock
methods.description: Locks the buffer for access, returning a pointer to the memory.

methods.name: lockYCbCr
methods.description: Locks the buffer for YCbCr format access.

methods.name: unlock
methods.description: Unlocks the buffer.

methods.name: lockAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously locks the buffer for access.

methods.name: lockAsyncYCbCr
methods.description: Asynchronously locks the buffer for YCbCr format access.

methods.name: unlockAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously unlocks the buffer.

methods.name: isSupported
methods.description: Checks if the buffer configuration is supported.

methods.name: getNativeBuffer
methods.description: Returns the native buffer pointer.

methods.name: dumpAllocationsToSystemLog
methods.description: Logs current buffer allocations for debugging.

methods.name: getFlattenedSize
methods.description: Returns size needed to flatten the object.

methods.name: getFdCount
methods.description: Returns the number of file descriptors to flatten.

methods.name: flatten
methods.description: Flattens the object into a buffer for IPC.

methods.name: unflatten
methods.description: Reconstructs the object from a flattened buffer.

methods.name: addDeathCallback
methods.description: Registers a callback to be invoked when the buffer is destroyed.
